_meta.guide: Wakespeed Communications and Configuration Guide v2.6.1
_meta.doc: See CLAUDE.md for the full schema key reference. Short list below.

field_keys.name: required - displayed label
field_keys.default: schema default; rendered in the Default column
field_keys.sensitive: 'password' - masked editor, empty default, Apply confirmation
field_keys.bits: [{value, label}] - renders the field as a row of checkboxes (unknown bits preserved)
field_keys.disabled_when: see 'Dependency mapping' in CLAUDE.md (simple, all_of, any_of forms)
field_keys.max_field: name of another field in the same command; this field must be strictly less
field_keys.preserve_when_disabled: true => when disabled by dep, keep editor editable + value (no snap to default). For safety-critical fields like Alt Derate (half)
field_keys.prefix_from: {command, field, map: {value-string: text}} - inserts dynamic-color prefix in desc
field_keys.rpm_bucket: {field, index} - inserts a computed 'RPM N-M:' prefix derived from RFM_RPM

commands.title: CAN Configuration
commands.summary: CAN bus identity, protocol enables, and remote sensing setup.

fields.name: Battery Instance Override
fields.desc: Battery instance this device is associated with (1..100). 0 = use DIP switches.

fields.name: Device Instance
fields.desc: Charger instance number. Should be unique per regulator.

fields.name: Device Priority
fields.desc: Relative charging priority for OSEnergy/RV-C coordination.

fields.name: AllowRBM

choices.label: No - do not act as RBM
Virtual RBM (re-transmits ALT_CAN data as RV-C)

fields.desc: Remote Battery Master role. Used with Enable_ALT_CAN, the virtual option re-broadcasts a 3rd-party CAN BMS as an RV-C device.

fields.name: ShuntAtBat
fields.desc: 1=shunt is on battery, 0=shunt is on alternator.

fields.name: Enable-OSE

choices.label: Enabled + allow Charge Profile via RV-C

fields.desc: OSEnergy (RV-C) Tx/Rx. Value 2 is not a valid setting.

fields.name: Enable-NMEA2000
fields.desc: NMEA-2000 status Tx. Suppression resolves conflicts with displays that select by Data Instance instead of Tx node. Value 2 is not valid.

fields.name: Enable_ALT_CAN

choices.label: SMA / Victron BMS w/ Zero Output
MG Energy Systems w/ Zero Output
Victron LYNX BMS w/ Zero Output

fields.desc: Alternative CAN BMS protocol. See Table 3 in the v2.6.1 guide. DO NOT use the 'Victron CAN-bus' option with Victron BMS - use LYNX instead. A real RV-C device, if present, takes precedence over any of these.

fields.name: Engine ID
fields.desc: J1939 engine ID this regulator is paired with (PGN 61444).

fields.name: BitRate
fields.desc: CAN bus bit rate.

fields.name: DC_Disconnected_VBat
fields.desc: Target VBat when DC-Disconnect is received via CAN. 0=disable. 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Aggregate_BMS
fields.desc: Number of additional battery instances to aggregate. 0=disabled.

fields.name: Enable-DVCC
fields.desc: Accept Victron DVCC directions. Requires alternator current sensing.

fields.name: CAN Alternator Data Instance
fields.desc: RV-C-style instance for CAN Alt current sensor (N2K PGN 127508). 0=disabled.

commands.title: Alternator / System
commands.summary: Alternator limits, derates, shunt, idle, warmup, required sensors.

fields.name: BTS2ATS
fields.desc: 1=use Battery Temp Sensor as 2nd Alternator Temp Sensor.

fields.name: Alt Target Temp
fields.desc: Alternator target operating temperature (deg C). +10% triggers fault.

fields.name: Alt Derate (norm)
fields.desc: Max field/output scaling in normal mode (0..1). CRITICAL FOR MANY 48V ALTS

fields.name: Alt Derate (small)
fields.desc: Max field/output scaling in Small-Alt mode. Selected via DIP switch 8, or by shorting the ATS sensor wires. Must be less than Alt Derate (norm). Note: Legacy.

fields.name: Alt Derate (half)
fields.desc: Max field/output scaling in Half-Power mode. Selected via Trigger Half-Power RPM (in $SCT) or via Feature-In (in $SCO, when set to Half-Power select). Must be less than Alt Derate (norm). CRITICAL FOR MANY 48V ALTS

fields.name: PBF
fields.desc: Pull-back factor at low RPM. -1 = special 70%% cap if RPM lost. 0 = disabled. Either/or with White Space (RFM in $CNG) - Wakespeed recommends White Space. Auto-disabled when RFM_RPM != 0.

fields.name: Alt Amp Cap
fields.desc: Max alternator amps. -1 = auto-sample at Bulk entry. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: System Watts Cap
fields.desc: Max system watts. -1 = auto-sample. 0 = disabled (15kW hard cap).

fields.name: Amp Shunt Ratio
fields.desc: Shunt ratio in A/mV * 1000-ish (e.g. 250A/75mV -> 3333).

fields.name: Shunt Reversed
fields.desc: 1 = invert measured amp polarity.

fields.name: Idle RPMs
fields.desc: Idle RPM for pull-back calc. 0 = auto-detect.

fields.name: Warmup Delay
fields.desc: Seconds in PRE-RAMP before applying load. Negative disables Fast Ramp. Valid range excludes -14..14.

fields.name: Required Sensors
fields.desc: Sensors that MUST be present. Missing -> warning (or FAULT if 'Force FAULT' is checked). Unknown bits in the file are preserved.

fields.name: Ignore Sensors
fields.desc: Sensors to ignore even if physically present. Unknown bits in the file are preserved.

fields.name: BMS Amp Cap
fields.desc: Max charge amps BMS can accept. 0=disabled. Clipped to 10A increments.

commands.title: Tachometer
commands.summary: Alternator poles, drive ratio, tach-mode field floor.

fields.name: Alt Poles
fields.desc: Number of poles in the alternator.

fields.name: Eng/Alt Drive Ratio
fields.desc: Engine pulley dia / Alt pulley dia.

fields.name: Tach Min Field
fields.desc: Min PWM %% when Tach-Mode on. Capped at 30%%. 0 = none. Used to drive an analog tachometer from the stator output. CAUTION: can overcharge and damage Lithium batteries - this forces field drive even when the regulator would otherwise stop charging.

fields.name: ForceTM
fields.desc: Force Tach-Mode on. When checked, the regulator drives the field with at least Tach Min Field %% so an analog tach can read RPM from the stator. Only enable if using the alternator output to drive a tachometer.

fields.name: Trigger Half-Power RPM
fields.desc: If engine RPM falls below this, force Half-Power mode. 0=disabled.

fields.name: Enable Wireless
fields.desc: 1 = enable Bluetooth (WS500 Pro).

fields.name: Reg Name
fields.desc: CAN ID name. No spaces, comma, or @.

fields.name: Reg Password
fields.desc: Empty = leave existing device password unchanged. Leading '.' = stored but hidden in NPC status. Factory default is '1234'.

commands.title: Overrides
commands.summary: DIP overrides, system voltage, lockout, Feature-In/Out behavior.

fields.name: CP_Index
fields.desc: Charge Profile select (1..8). 0 = use DIP. 8 = Custom, most use Custom, other Legacy.

fields.name: BC_Index
fields.desc: Battery Capacity multiplier. 0 = use DIP switches. Negative = ignore CAN-supplied value too. Literal text editor to preserve signed zero (-0.00 vs 0.00).

fields.name: SV_Override
fields.desc: System voltage. Drives UI scaling for every 12V-normalized field. Changing this affects how voltages are displayed throughout the app - reopen the file after changing to refresh all voltage editors.

fields.name: Lockout
fields.desc: Configuration lockout. Level 2 is irreversible without a factory return.

fields.name: Feature-IN
fields.desc:
Feature-In wire is triggered by +ve DC signal.
0 - Default - Active -> Equalize (CP 1..7) or Float (CP 8). Inactive -> Normal Charging.
1 - CP 8 only. (Invert) Active -> Normal Charging. Inactive -> Float.
2 - Half Power (invert) Active -> Full Power. Inactive -> Alt_Derate (Half).

Override - when $CNG RFM_RPM > 0, Feature-IN is repurposed to control White Space and this setting is IGNORED.

fields.name: Feature-OUT
fields.desc: Function assigned to the Feature-Out pin.

fields.name: Promiscuous Mode
fields.desc: 1 = let some hard faults self-reset (see Appendix E 0x4000).

commands.title: Engine Configuration
commands.summary: J1939 load cap, RPM-based White-Space (RFM), EGT setpoint.

fields.name: J1939MaxLoad
fields.desc: Max allowed J1939 engine load fraction (PGN 61443). 0 = disabled.

fields.name: RFM_RPM
fields.desc:
Upper engine RPM for the 8x White-Space derate buckets. The sign of this value also controls how the Feature-In wire behaves:

0 = White Space disabled (RFM1..8 inactive). Feature-In keeps its $SCO Feature-IN function.
Positive (eg 3000) - White Space function Enabled when Feature In has +ve signal applied. Overrides $SCO Feature-IN.
Negative (eg -3000) - White Space always on. Feature-IN managed by $SCO.

Either/or with PBF ($SCA): if PBF is non-zero, this field is auto-disabled.

fields.name: RFM1
fields.desc: Derate multiplier (0..1) for this RPM bucket.

fields.name: RFM2
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM3
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM4
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM5
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM6
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM7
fields.desc: Derate multiplier.

fields.name: RFM8
fields.desc: Derate multiplier (top bucket, no upper RPM limit).

fields.name: EGT_Setpoint
fields.desc: EGT regulator target (deg C, WS500 Pro only). 0 = disabled. Optional - may be omitted.

fields.name: Version(s)
fields.desc: Comma-separated dependency tags. mmmmxx.yy.zz - e.g. AREG2.4.2, DCDC2.4.3.

fields.name: VBat Set Point
fields.desc: Acceptance voltage. 12V-normalized in file.

fields.name: Exit Duration
fields.desc: Minutes in Accept before moving to Overcharge. 0 = no time exit.

fields.name: Exit Amps
fields.desc: Exit when amps <= this. -1 = adaptive (5x bulk time). 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Reserved
fields.desc: Must be 0.

commands.title: Charge Profile - OVERCHARGE
commands.summary: Optional finish phase between Accept and Float. Set Limit Amps = 0 to disable Overcharge.

fields.name: Limit Amps
fields.desc: Regulated amps in OC. 0 = disable OC (greys out the rest). -1 = special mode (see guide). 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Exit Duration
fields.desc: Minutes before exit to Float.

fields.name: Exit VBat
fields.desc: VBat at which to exit OC. 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Exit Amps
fields.desc: Exit when acceptance current <= this. 500Ah-normalized.

commands.title: Charge Profile - FLOAT
commands.summary: Float voltage, current cap, revert-to-Bulk triggers.

fields.name: VBat Set Point
fields.desc: Float voltage. 0 = stop charging in Float. 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Limit Amps
fields.desc: Amp cap in Float. -1 = no cap, voltage-only. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Exit Duration
fields.desc: Minutes before moving to Post-Float. 0 = stay.

fields.name: Revert Amps
fields.desc: Negative draw triggering revert to Bulk. 0 = disabled. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Revert Amp-hours
fields.desc: Negative AH withdrawn triggering revert. 0 = disabled. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Revert Volts
fields.desc: VBat below which to revert to Bulk. 0 = disabled. 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Revert SOC
fields.desc: SOC %% below which to revert (CAN BMS required). 0 = disabled.

commands.title: Charge Profile - POST-FLOAT
commands.summary: After Float: timer and revert-to-Bulk triggers.

fields.name: Exit Duration
fields.desc: Minutes in Post-Float before re-entering Bulk. 0 = stay.

fields.name: Revert VBat
fields.desc: VBat below which to revert to Bulk. 0 = disabled. 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Revert Amp-hours
fields.desc: Negative AH withdrawn triggering direct revert to Bulk. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: VBat Set Point
fields.desc: Post-Float regulated voltage. 0 = charging disabled. 12V-normalized.

commands.title: Charge Profile - EQUALIZE
commands.summary: Equalization voltage, amp cap, time/amp exits. Set VBat Set Point = 0 to disable Equalize.

fields.name: VBat Set Point
fields.desc: Equalize voltage. 0 = disable Equalize (greys out the rest). 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Max Amps
fields.desc: Optional amp cap. 0 = no cap. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Exit Duration
fields.desc: Minutes of Equalize.

fields.name: Exit Amps
fields.desc: Exit when amps <= this (VBat not checked). 0 = time-only. 500Ah-normalized.

commands.title: Charge Profile - BATTERY
commands.summary: Temp comp, charge temp limits, reduced-charge, hard caps.

fields.name: VBat Comp per 1C
fields.desc: V/deg C compensation, 12V-normalized at 25C. 0 = disabled. Scales with system voltage.

fields.name: Min Comp Temp
fields.desc: Stop adding comp at/below this batt temp (deg C).

fields.name: Min Charge Temp
fields.desc: Disable charging below this batt temp (deg C).

fields.name: Max Charge Temp
fields.desc: Disable above this batt temp; fault at +20%.

fields.name: Rdc Volts
fields.desc: VBat at/below which to enter Reduced Charge mode. 0 = disabled (greys out Rdc Low/High Temp, Rdc Amps). 12V-normalized.

fields.name: Rdc Low Temp
fields.desc: Batt temp at/below which to enter Reduced Charge. -99 = disabled.

fields.name: Rdc High Temp
fields.desc: Batt temp at/above which to enter Reduced Charge. -99 = disabled.

fields.name: Rdc Amps
fields.desc: Amp cap in Reduced Charge mode. 0 = disabled. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Max Bat Amps
fields.desc: Hard max amps into battery. 0 = disabled. 500Ah-normalized.

fields.name: Max Bat Volts
fields.desc: Hard max VBat fault trip. 0 = disabled. 12V-normalized.
